players.product: QCT single-molecule NGS (smNGS) prenatal (UNITY) and oncology (Northstar) cell-free DNA tests with proprietary algorithms

quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q litigation: on May 7, 2026 Illumina, Inc. filed a lawsuit in the U.S. District Court in the State of Delaware alleging that BillionToOne's UNITY test infringes U.S. Patent Nos. 10,612,096, 12,139,760 and 12,435,373. BillionToOne maintains the allegations are without merit, is vigorously defending itself and does not believe a loss is probable or reasonably estimable.
quarterly_data.figure: Illumina patent suit filed May 7, 2026 (three U.S. patents)
